title: BlueAndGoldPvP
description: A stunning blue and gold themed PvP resource pack. Clean items and armor for 1.21!
body:
### ⚡ blue and gold

Welcome to blue and gold, a custom-themed PvP resource pack built for performance, clarity, and style. Based on the signature blue and gold color palette of Stratosghost's main skin, this pack gives your Minecraft gear a royal, high-contrast look that stands out in any fight.

Whether you are grinding BedWars, dueling, or playing survival, this pack delivers a clean and aesthetically pleasing experience.
